subject: Roshan animation: one constant size
question: Review of the whole-frame bending wave (Claude revision 2, assets_src/cinematics/claude_whole_frame_wave_20261005).
decision: Rejected: "This is worse than the previous results, roshan mutates in size still." Roshan keeps one size through an animation, including her head, arms and hands, not only her overall figure.

subject: Sprites drawn whole, as a single unit (game-wide)
question: Review of the wave studies, whose frames were built from stacked or separately warped pieces.
decision: "There are also significant overdraw issues, sprites need to be drawn whole, as a single unit, in this game." Each sprite frame is one whole drawing; no part layers, stacked copies or cross-fades.
